Hi Samantha and team — looping in Neha from Security. Quick answers and artifacts attached. See below for the bulleted summary for procurement and legal.

Attachments: redwood-incident-response-snapshot.pdf, dr-runbook-excerpt.pdf

SOC2
- Status: SOC 2 Type II, report issued Sep 2025. Scope: control plane, model serving runtime, identity and access management controls. We do not publish the full report publicly; we provide secured, auditor-accessible portal links on request.

Data protection / GDPR / HIPAA
- We support data residency controls and can restrict processing to customer-specified regions (standard option: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1 for Enterprise plans).
- PHI: We process PHI under a DPA and specific contractual terms. We are happy to review Bridgewell's DPA and sign where consistent with our security model.

Incident response and breach notification
- Detection -> initial customer security notification: target within 24 hours of detection for incidents with potential customer data impact.
- Formal initial incident report: delivered within 72 hours with current impact, containment steps, next actions, and estimated remediation timeline.
- For confirmed breaches involving PHI we commit to the contractual notification timelines in the executed DPA. For procurement review purposes, our baseline is 72 hours for formal reporting; we will collaborate on any accelerated timelines required by Bridgewell.

Business continuity / DR
- RTO targets (prioritization dependent): critical serving paths 8-12 hours; non-critical control plane tasks restored within 24-48 hours.
- RPO: typical <4 hours for critical keys and caches; longer for non-essential telemetry.
- We included a short DR runbook excerpt as requested.

Portal & next steps
- SOC2 access: request access via this secure link: https://redwood-secure.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2-portal/access-request?id=BRIDGEWELL-2026 (access requires an NDA or recipient email subscription).
- I've uploaded IR snapshot and DR excerpt for procurement review. If Bridgewell prefers a vendor-signed DPA template, please send and we will have legal review it; otherwise we can propose our DPA.

Internal ref: HUBSPOT DEAL DEAL-2026-0421; internal ticket SEC-1364.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
